hypothesis: Joint monotone one-to-one assignment with explicit unmatched pixels may reduce false-near correspondences that independent local winners accept.
single_change: Replace independent pixel winners with exact joint scanline assignment; use byte-identical v56 7x7 Census / 3x3 Hamming costs and complete support. No local cost tuning.
novelty: SGBM penalizes disparity transitions and postchecks LR; old ownership only rejects colliding already-generated sampled partners. This candidate optimizes full image joint one-to-one ordering plus per-pixel occlusion transitions, generating correspondences before downstream filtering.
input: Current RGB pair, frozen native vertical stereo calibration f=584.8888888888889 px and baseline=.6m, existing static CAD mask. Native IMU/encoder pose and dynamic CAD only in inherited projection consumer. No truth, task geometry or future input to estimator.

matching.rectification: 90deg CCW native vertical stereo; partner xr=xl-d
matching.local_cost: byte-identical v56 7x7 strict Census48 and complete9x9 bilateral CAD support, 3x3 summed Hamming
matching.match_domain: all positive integer disparities with true bilateral support, no padding, matchcost<=108 inherited
matching.gap_cost: 54 for each supported unmatched pixel, exactly half inherited108 match ceiling; unsupported pixels gap0
matching.objective: min total matched cost plus left/right gap costs over full monotone scanline alignment from(0,0)to(W,W)
matching.ambiguity: accept pair only if the same partner occurs on all globally minimal alignments and skipping that left pixel is impossible on any minimum alignment; any exact alternative -> unknown
matching.disparity: integer only; no local subpixel movement that could violate ordering
matching.unknown: gap/ambiguity/CAD/out-of-range -> NaN, no risk clearing or observed free

coverage: 5 complete 181-pair 0..90s sequences, H/E0/E1 and both v54 arms all previously seen development. No independent holdout claim. Original forward/height trajectory shares group H; no duplicate counting.
gate_denominators: Finite error is conditional on candidate confidence and finite rendered surface, not all pixels. Full-image coverage and nohit predictions reported separately. Obstacle retention is original accepted query pixels with GT surface height .05..1.5m still accepted by new fixed downstream consumer, not visible-scene recall. All gates frozen before any candidate outputs or scores.
output_order: all905 outputs and complete map updates sealed before GT reads; source gates identical to v56; no candidate tuning
maps: same recorded native trajectory; preserve original risk consumer. Map changes are offline counterfactual, not actual navigation. H original uses repeated exposure, others viewpoint confirmation.
stop: Any complete source gate failure closes candidate and unused physical budget. No sweep, descriptor swap, repeat tuning or rehabilitation of old candidates. Passing source still requires separately registered same-version 90s navigation comparison within cap.
privileges: Ideal native IMU, encoder rolling estimate, privileged initial gauge and fixed .4m height prior inherited; GT surface depth/body-band reference only offline scoring. Unknown geometry not treated free.
